channel.title: Rust on 梦兽编程
channel.description: Recent content in Rust on 梦兽编程

item.title: Why Rust Makes C++ Programmers Lose Sleep at Night: Lessons from My Migration Journey
item.description: A C++ developer with 5 years of experience shares real insights from switching to Rust. From memory safety to concurrency, these 10 features completely changed my perspective on systems programming

item.title: 500 Lines of Rust, 10 Seconds to Train: How Simple Is Building a Neural Network from Scratch?
item.description: Build a spam classifier neural network with Rust and Hugging Face's Candle framework in just 500 lines of code. From tokenizer to embedding to Softmax, every step explained like a cooking recipe. No GPU, no Python, runs on any laptop.

item.title: 4000 Pages Per Second: The Rust PDF Library That's Changing the Game
item.description: oxidize-pdf: A pure-Rust PDF engine with zero C dependencies, a 5MB binary, and performance that leaves Chromium and Java stacks in the dust.

item.title: PostgreSQL Query Parsing Too Slow? PgDog Ditched Protobuf and Got 5x Faster
item.description: PgDog is a Rust-based PostgreSQL proxy. They discovered Protobuf serialization was the real bottleneck in SQL query parsing — not the Postgres parser itself. By replacing Protobuf with direct C-to-Rust FFI bindings, they achieved 5-10x faster parsing.

item.title: Rust Compiler Error 'cannot borrow as mutable'? Think of s.clear() as 'Tearing a Book'
item.description: Why does s.clear() cause a mutable borrow error? This article uses a 'library book' analogy to help you thoroughly understand Rust's borrowing rules and lifetime conflicts.

item.title: Brave Browser Rewrites Ad Blocker in Rust, Slashes Memory by 75%
item.description: Brave 1.85 rewrites its ad-blocking engine using Rust and FlatBuffers, reducing memory usage from 60MB to 15MB. Here's how they did it.

item.title: Stop Writing Some(...): The impl Into<Option<T>> Trick in Rust
item.description: Learn how to use Rust's Into Trait with Option to let functions accept both raw values and Option types, eliminating tedious Some() wrapping.

item.title: Rust 1.93 Released: musl Upgrade, Assembly Conditional Compilation, Zero-Copy Suite
item.description: Rust 1.93 is out with all musl targets upgraded to 1.2.5, #[cfg] conditional compilation in assembly, global allocators can now use TLS, and zero-copy APIs stabilized.

item.title: Rust GCC Compiler Backend: Install rustc-codegen-gcc with One Command
item.description: rustc-codegen-gcc is now officially part of rustup nightly components. Linux users can now experience GCC-compiled Rust code with a single command. No more manual compilation, no more environment setup hassles—it's like giving Rust a new engine.

item.title: Rust's Standard Library Now Runs on GPUs: What Did They Actually Do
item.description: VectorWare team made Rust's std library work on GPUs. You can now use println!, read files, and get system time inside GPU kernels. Here's how they pulled it off.

item.title: Const Generics: This Rust Feature Cut Our Code by 85%
item.description: From 8,347 lines to 1,243 lines — the rebirth of a cryptography library

item.title: The Rust Async Trap Everyone Steps On Once
item.description: It compiles. It runs. It even passes stress tests... until production catches fire. Let's talk about that classic async Rust pitfall everyone hits.

item.title: Rust Design Patterns: 3 Best Practices Senior Backend Engineers Always Use
item.description: Discover the Rust design patterns senior engineers swear by: Newtype pattern prevents invalid states, ownership design reflects system boundaries, enum error handling makes failures predictable. Master these Rust best practices to build rock-solid backend code and say goodbye to midnight incidents.

item.title: I Rewrote Our Python Data Pipeline in Rust: 3 Hours to 4 Minutes, 40x Faster
item.description: A real-world case study of rewriting a Python data pipeline with Rust + DuckDB. From 3-hour daily ETL jobs to 4-minute runs, memory usage dropped from 12GB to 600MB, and server costs cut by two-thirds.

item.title: Rust Compiler Pipeline Refactor: 35% Faster Build Times, But There's a Catch
item.description: Our team's CI dropped from 42 minutes to 27 minutes just by upgrading the Rust compiler. This journey taught us one thing: performance optimization rewards those who measure, punishes those who guess.

item.title: Rust Lifetimes Scare Away 90% of Programmers? One Library Analogy Gets You There in Seconds
item.description: Compiler errors got you running? Relax. Rust lifetimes aren't scary monsters—they're invisible guardians ensuring your code never crashes. This 5-minute guide beats the official docs.

item.title: Rust Performance Pitfalls: When Rust Runs Slower Than Python
item.description: Rust performance optimization in practice: I watched my Rust rewrite get crushed by Python. The problem was data structure choice.

item.title: From 800ms to 90ms: How Rust Rayon Saved My Multithreading Nightmare
item.description: A real Rust concurrency case study: replacing manual threads with Rayon's work-stealing scheduler and getting a 9x speedup.

item.title: io_uring Guide: Building High-Performance Servers with Rust and Async IO
item.description: A friendly deep-dive into Linux io_uring async IO technology, learn how to build high-performance servers with Rust and escape syscall bottlenecks

item.title: Rust mmap Memory-Mapped I/O: Why Reading Files Can Be as Fast as Accessing Memory
item.description: A plain-English guide to Rust mmap memory-mapped I/O. Why is it 5-10x faster than traditional Rust file reading? How does zero-copy achieve Rust performance optimization? This memmap2 hands-on tutorial uses real-life analogies to help you understand this seemingly mysterious low-level technology.

item.title: Rust 1.90 Upgrade Crash Report: My Codebase Didn't Make It
item.description: Performance tanked after upgrading to Rust 1.90? Here's why and how to claw it back.

item.title: Running Rust Async on Windows? Meet the Little Devil in the Closet: Device Afd
item.description: Why does Rust async work on Windows? Unveiling Microsoft's undocumented AFD driver with real-world analogies to understand Windows async programming under the hood

item.title: Rust Macros 2.0 Starter Guide: Build Code Like Lego
item.description: A panoramic Rust Macros 2.0 guide: unify macro namespaces, master the TokenStream pipeline and macro hygiene, and migrate from macro 1.0 to macro 2.0 metaprogramming with practical examples.

item.title: Rust 1.90: The Update Developers Have Been Begging For
item.description: If Rust build times have ever ruined your coding flow, this release fixes what matters most

item.title: Rust Async Microservices, Tamed: Rate Limiting, Backpressure, Batching, and Middleware
item.description: When traffic surges like a flood, equip your Rust microservices with four gates—rate limiting, backpressure, batching, and middleware—using Tokio + Tower. Keep P99 steady and make speed happen in order.

item.title: Rust + Axum Async Microservice Guide: Job Queue, Retries, and Graceful Shutdown
item.description: Build a production-ready async microservice with Rust and Axum: job queue, background workers, exponential backoff retries, and graceful shutdown. Includes full project structure and Docker example.

item.title: Rust Axum Graceful Shutdown, The Ultimate Guide: Fix the pitfall 99% of engineers hit
item.description: Master graceful shutdown for Rust Axum services: listen for SIGINT/SIGTERM, refuse new connections with with_graceful_shutdown, stop background tasks via CancellationToken, set timeouts, and integrate with Docker/Kubernetes termination — protect data integrity and user experience.

item.title: Rust + Axum, from zero to hero: build a high‑performance Web server the LEGO way
item.description: A step‑by‑step Axum guide to build a modern high‑performance Web service: routing, path and query parameters, JSON, shared state, and middleware (tracing, CORS) with complete code samples and best practices.

item.title: Rust unsafe isn’t a toy — it’s a blood oath: 6 YOLO mistakes that will blow up your code
item.description: Don’t treat unsafe like a get-out-of-jail-free card. With practical examples, this article dissects 6 common unsafe pitfalls: silencing the compiler with duct tape, dereferencing random raw pointers, violating borrow rules inside unsafe, reinventing wheels, abusing unsafe impl, and skipping Safety comments — helping you build the right risk mindset and usage patterns.

item.title: Stop treating tokio::spawn as a thread! I launched 1000 tasks in 2 seconds and the system stayed calm
item.description: tokio::spawn is not a thread but a lightweight task. Under Tokio's scheduler you build highly concurrent services with sleep, timeout and select — 1000 tasks in 2 seconds with negligible overhead.

item.title: Rust Async State Machine, Unmasked: How Future, poll, and Waker Really Work
item.description: A practical deep dive into Rust async: why calling an async function doesn't run it, how the compiler turns async into a state machine, and how executors drive tasks forward with poll and Waker. Understand the real mechanics behind async/await.

item.title: Rust 1.89: Intel Macs demoted to Tier 2, clearer lifetimes, and new x86 intrinsics
item.description: Rust 1.89 demotes x86_64-apple-darwin (Intel Mac) from Tier 1 to Tier 2, adds the mismatched_lifetime_syntaxes lint, constant generics '_' inference, and a wave of new x86 intrinsics.

item.title: Rust Cluster Commands: Managing Distributed Systems Like Conducting an Orchestra
item.description: Learn how to implement cluster-level control commands in Rust distributed actor systems, making node management as elegant as conducting a symphony

item.title: I Told Old Zhang His Rust Service Might Be 10x Slower - He Almost Spit Coffee in My Face
item.description: Rust service suddenly 10x slower? The problem might be hiding in Serde macros. This article walks through a real story to help you identify and fix performance issues caused by Serde serialization.

item.title: Rust File Distribution & Hot Reload: Managing Your Code Like a Delivery Network Pro
item.description: Learn Rust file distribution, config synchronization, and hot code reloading through vivid delivery service analogies - manage code deployment like running a delivery empire

item.title: Rust Async Unveiled: The Secret to Making Code 'Slack Off' While Doubling Efficiency!
item.description: Deep dive into Rust async programming core concepts, from async/await to Future, from tokio runtime to concurrent processing. Master zero-cost async programming essence and double your Rust code efficiency!
